note: Both sets cover the same 12 facts from the slide (aperture/diameter, instrument counts, Lynx focal length, starshade diameter) with correct values, units and baseline-concept conditions. Set B binds the 10 m focal length more precisely to the Lynx grazing-incidence mirror assembly, while Set A keeps entity context in its quotes (e.g. 'Lynx: ...three science instruments') where B's short quotes ('three science instruments', 'a 10 m focal length') lack the component context. Neither set invents or misbinds anything, and both omit the same minor condition (starshade 'flying in formation'), so the sets are effectively equivalent.
remarks: Both sets miss the condition that the HabEx starshade spacecraft flies in formation with the telescope spacecraft, and neither notes that the starshade is a separate spacecraft. Set B's quotes for the Lynx instrument count and focal length are context-free fragments, though they still support the claims within the bullet. Set A's quotes use added prefixes ('Lynx: ...') and ellipses, which are slightly reconstructed rather than verbatim, but faithful to the text.
